request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Turn it into a layered-cake galleon: the hull becomes layers of pale cream sponge cake #f3dfb8 with pale pink frosting #ffb8d8 dripping from its top edge; the stone castle becomes a round cake tower with white whipped cream on top; the red sails become white cream sails; the masts become pink and white striped candy canes; the pennants become pale pink. Nothing red. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
